Supreme Court of the United States 
One First Street, N.E. 
Washington, D.C. 20543 

Re: 

Shular v. United States, No. 18-6662 

Dear Mr. Harris and Ms. McNerney: 

This letter concerns the scheduling for the above-captioned case. After conferring with 
the Office of the Solicitor General, we have agreed to propose the following briefing schedule: 

Wednesday, September 25, 2019 for the Brief for Petitioner 

Friday, November 22, 2019 for the Brief of the United States as Respondent 

Friday, December 20, 2019 for the Reply Brief 

If there are any questions, please do not hesitate to contact me. 

Sincerely,  

Jeffrey T. Green 
Sidley Austin LLP 
1501 K Street, N.W. 
Washington, D.C. 20005 
(202) 736-8000

      Jonathan Bond
